order.title: Two ways to order the path
order.body: Defensible minimum puts the biggest risk and legal exposure first. Chronological follows the natural process, category by category.

filters.title: Narrow it to what needs you
filters.body: Filter the path down to what is open, overdue, due soon, or waiting on a sign-off.

legend.title: What the dots mean
legend.body: Every dot carries a state: now, in progress, awaiting sign-off, or signed off.

firstStep.title: Every row is one requirement
firstStep.body: Open a row to see what the requirement asks for and what to do about it. Start at the top and work down.

status.title: Where this requirement stands
status.body: The badge next to the title tracks the requirement from open through to signed off.

form.title: Answer the specifics
form.body: Edit records what your organisation actually does. Save keeps it, and your answers become part of the evidence.

evidence.title: Attach the proof
evidence.body: Upload the documents that show the measure is really running. That is what an audit asks for.

assign.title: Give it an owner, then sign it off
assign.body: Assign the person responsible and sign off once the requirement is met. The sign-off is the record that management agreed.

nav.title: Move through the path
nav.body: Back and next walk the requirements in order. Mark one as not applicable where it does not apply to your organisation, with a reason.

help.title: Anything we can help with?
help.body: This is your second time here. If something is unclear or you are stuck, say so. You reach us directly.
help.selfHost: Want to run the platform on your own infrastructure? We help with that too.
help.feedback: Telling us what is missing or awkward is just as welcome as a question.
